author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: boxy straps with angular '>' armholes and a square outline, so the top read as a letter Y or a cat head over a box. After: the reference's vest silhouette: straps into smoothly curved armholes, straight sides with rounded hem corners, a V-neck into a centre zip, and two reflective bands 8 apart; reads as a hi-vis vest at 48 in both themes.
omissions: Bottom-centre hem notch omitted; bands kept at 8 spacing above the hem.
